metadata.question: Did Cambodia experience forest loss between 2001 and 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use the Global Forest Change dataset (Hansen et al.), which provides tree cover loss year-by-year since 2001. Cambodia is the area of interest. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed – the GFC product is already a clean annual loss layer. 3. Logic: Sum all “loss” pixels flagged between 2001 and 2014 inside Cambodia. If total > 0 → forest loss occurred (A); if 0 → no loss (B); if collection empty or no valid pixels → C1/C2; if result None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time cambodia = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017").filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia')).geometry() start_year, end_year = 2001, 2014 # 2. Data acquisition gfc = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_9') loss_img = gfc.select(['lossyear']).clip(cambodia) years = list(range(start_year, end_year + 1)) loss_multi = loss_img.eq(years).reduce('sum').rename('loss_01_14') # 3. Pixel count & value px_sum = loss_multi.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=cambodia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('loss_01_14').getInfo() px_count = loss_multi.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=cambodia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('loss_01_14').getInfo() if px_sum is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") elif int(px_count) == 0: print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") else: print(f'Forest loss pixels 2001-2014: {int(px_sum)}') if px_sum > 0: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
cambodia = ee.FeatureCollection("USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017").filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Cambodia')).geometry()
start_year, end_year = 2001, 2014

# 2. Data acquisition
gfc = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_9')
loss_img = gfc.select(['lossyear']).clip(cambodia)
years = list(range(start_year, end_year + 1))
loss_multi = loss_img.eq(years).reduce('sum').rename('loss_01_14')

# 3. Pixel count & value
px_sum = loss_multi.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=cambodia,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('loss_01_14').getInfo()

px_count = loss_multi.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=cambodia,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('loss_01_14').getInfo()

if px_sum is None:
    print("Calculation returned None.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif int(px_count) == 0:
    print("No valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print(f'Forest loss pixels 2001-2014: {int(px_sum)}')
    if px_sum > 0:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
